dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Could you tell me more about that tour group you mentioned earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Decai
dialogues.text: *cough* Ahem! Good Miss, our name is, in truth, "Seniorjoy Tours," the go-to choice for all filial young folks looking to treat their parents or grandparents!

dialogues.speaker: Wangfa
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, yes. And here's the itinerary...
